question: In which of the following dances from Manipur is the drum prominently used as a part of dance movements?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Pung Cholom.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In** Pung Cholom in Manipur**, The Drum is prominently used as a part of the Dance Movement.
 
• A barrel drum is used in the Pung dance form as a rhythmic instrument.
 
• Manipuri is an ancient classical dance form of Manipur.
 
• Manipuri originated in the northeastern state of Manipur in India.
